linux.command: PROJ=""; if [ -f "${workspaceFolder}/MP4Tools/MP4Tools.csproj" ]; then PROJ="${workspaceFolder}/MP4Tools/MP4Tools.csproj"; elif [ -f "${workspaceFolder}/MP4Tools.csproj" ]; then PROJ="${workspaceFolder}/MP4Tools.csproj"; else echo "build-app: could not find MP4Tools.csproj (open repo root or MP4Tools/)." >&2; exit 1; fi; dotnet build "$PROJ" -c Debug /property:GenerateFullPaths=true '/consoleloggerparameters:NoSummary;ForceNoAlign'

osx.command: PROJ=""; if [ -f "${workspaceFolder}/MP4Tools/MP4Tools.csproj" ]; then PROJ="${workspaceFolder}/MP4Tools/MP4Tools.csproj"; elif [ -f "${workspaceFolder}/MP4Tools.csproj" ]; then PROJ="${workspaceFolder}/MP4Tools.csproj"; else echo "build-app: could not find MP4Tools.csproj (open repo root or MP4Tools/)." >&2; exit 1; fi; dotnet build "$PROJ" -c Debug /property:GenerateFullPaths=true '/consoleloggerparameters:NoSummary;ForceNoAlign'

windows.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath '${workspaceFolder}\MP4Tools\MP4Tools.csproj') { '${workspaceFolder}\MP4Tools\MP4Tools.csproj' } elseif (Test-Path -LiteralPath '${workspaceFolder}\MP4Tools.csproj') { '${workspaceFolder}\MP4Tools.csproj' } else { Write-Error 'build-app: could not find MP4Tools.csproj'; exit 1 }; dotnet build $p -c Debug /property:GenerateFullPaths=true '/consoleloggerparameters:NoSummary;ForceNoAlign'"
